question: Should `bus:pubsub` become a supported capability in the bundled Workspaces custom-widget contract now?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and appears correct, but automation cannot decide the long-term product and compatibility commitment of exposing a new API to approved agent-authored widgets.

options.title: Sponsor After Proof
options.body: Adopt the proposed parent-brokered API after an exact-head two-widget browser demonstration confirms its documented isolation and lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Keep Widgets Isolated
options.body: Decline the API expansion until maintainers choose a different or narrower widget-coordination contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Proof
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed parent-brokered API after an exact-head two-widget browser demonstration confirms its documented isolation and lifecycle behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the current Workspaces foundation and is the strongest available owner for deciding whether this extension joins its supported product contract.
